My approach

☻

Personalized

You bring your own ideas, references or thoughts. I help you shape them into something real.
Everyone works on their own thing, at their own rhythm, without following a fixed path.

❋

No Rules

The idea is to explore and learn through mistakes.
Sometimes breaking the rules or following a “mistake” is what helps you find your own style.

✦

Goes at your pace

No pressure, no rush.
You work at your own pace, repeat things, pause, try again. whatever feels right.

✿

Community

It’s not just about making things. It’s about being around others doing the same.
You share ideas, learn from each other, and grow together in a relaxed, open space.

Made by hand, in the studio
